title: AI Cel Shading Generator
summary: Make cel-shaded art and animation with AI. Describe the scene, pick a cel shading style, and Flick makes flat-shaded images and video. Free to try.
body_markdown:
### What is cel shading?


Cel shading, or toon shading, is a way of rendering images with a few flat tones and hard-edged shadows instead of smooth gradients, often with dark outlines, so 3D scenes or digital art look like hand-painted animation cels.


### Why is it called cel shading?


The name comes from cels, the clear celluloid sheets that animators painted characters onto in traditional 2D animation; the flat, hard-edged colour of those painted sheets is the look cel shading copies.


### Can AI make cel-shaded art?


Yes. Flick generates cel-shaded images and video from a text description; ask for flat tones, hard-edged shadows and clean outlines, and pick a cel shading style so every shot keeps the same look.


### What is the difference between cel shading and anime?


Anime is a style of animation from Japan, while cel shading is a lighting technique; most traditional anime is cel-shaded, but cel shading is also used for Western cartoons and 3D video games.


### How do I make a cel-shaded animation?


Generate a cel-shaded still or a character reference, then animate it with a video model in Flick, asking for the character to be animated on twos and ruling out 3D render and motion blur so the flat shading holds.


### Is the cel shading generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every week with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on it. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
